title: UAAP: UST sends UE crashing back to earth, bolsters Final Four bid
summary: University of Santo Tomas sent University of the East crashing back to earth with a 97-70 rout in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
